items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 2, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I used to love driving him up to Hamilton, I just used to love chatting with him.

ctx.x: Somehow it just didn’t seem fair that this took him.

It wasn’t fair at all, no. I agree, the saddest thing of all, I get chills thinking about it now, that John and Martin and Mary and the whole family — I don’t know for sure but this disease was so awful that you couldn’t be around your loved ones. That is just — I can’t even fathom that. I can’t fathom that. And of course Ruth going a week later you know. That’s the saddest thing of all. It isn’t fair you know what I mean? I mean he was such a survivor and such a wonderful guy. And I used to love driving him up…
Yes. We treasure those moments maybe more than we did.
